description: Ex FAB AT-26 4561 (c/n 76-100-343, the 100th Xavante), Aviación Naval 0785/4-A-138 from September 1982, rebuilt after 1996 damage, retired 2007; donated 2013, restored by local veterans and mounted on a pedestal 3 April 2021 with mesh over the intakes. Photographed 2 October 2021 and 27 May 2022.
